scope: Two read-only application/database research questions; no production rewrite

questions.P1: Relationalize a closed, typed application intermediate consumed by SQL
questions.P2: Derive a consumer-sufficient key relation and restrict derived computation

finite_model.consumer: already determined target occurrence order, slice, then output key/count pairs

binding_obligations.requirement: All intermediate consumers known; no escaping map, logging effect or unmodeled branch
Decode/app compute/encode commutes with DB expression over the admitted domain
Missing entity, absent group, NULL and typed zero remain distinct as required
All authorization, tenant and manager predicates retained
Page membership and ordering independent of derived value; every additional consumer included
Omitted computation cannot raise a business error or produce an observable effect
All dependency reads share the fixed snapshot/context, with no relevant self-writes
Original order sufficient for exact output; candidate adds no tie-breaker

pending_database_checks: P1 scalar absent district versus present district with empty count
P1 scalar Java/JDBC/SQL integer boundaries and unsupported conversion rejection
P1 map empty groups, duplicate target occurrences and duplicate association rows
P1/P2 authorization and effective manager predicates retained
P2 independent page accepted, count-dependent page rejected, unknown consumer remains unknown
P2 hidden global aggregate consumer and possible omitted overflow rejected
Complete typed ordered outputs and read-only state compared against original
Unknown or invalid binding leaves the original path unchanged

constraints: no production API claim from model fixture
report negative results without expanding matrix
